I am an old woman of 62 years, farming here in Kilimanjaro on my small rice plot. I have no schooling and little money, so I depend on the manure from my few animals and the seeds I save from last season. The chemical fertilizer from the shop is too expensive for me, and my plot sits near the lowland where water comes down from the mountain, so I can flood it when the rains are good. My children and grandchildren help me in the field, but when it is time to transplant and harvest I must call some neighbors to help for a little money or a share of the harvest.
